scenario: Create a rider with all valid data
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Click Save.
data:
First Name: Pedro Jose
Last Name: Garcia
Date of Birth: 03/22/1995
Email: pedrojose.garcia@example.com
Mobile Number: 09451239876
Driver's License No.: N01-23-456789
License Expiry Date: 03/22/2030
Vehicle Type: Motorcycle
Plate Number: 123ABC
Driver's License (upload): drivers_license.jpg (1.5 MB)
Vehicle OR/CR (upload): or_cr.pdf (900 KB)
expected: The rider is saved with no validation errors and appears in the rider list of Bilis Hatid Express Inc. with status Pending Activation. An activation email is sent to pedrojose.garcia@example.com.

scenario: Submit a completely empty form
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Leave every field blank and every dropdown on its default option.
2. Click Save.
data: All fields blank
expected: Saving is blocked. A required-field message is shown for every mandatory field. No rider is created and no email is sent.

scenario: Leave one required field blank at a time
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all fields with valid data.
2. Clear one required field.
3. Click Save.
4. Repeat for each field in the test data.
data:
Clear in turn:
First Name
Last Name
Date of Birth
Email
Mobile Number
Driver's License No.
License Expiry Date
Vehicle Type
Plate Number
Driver's License (upload)
Vehicle OR/CR (upload)
expected: Each time, saving is blocked and a required-field message is shown on the blank field only. Other entered values (except uploads) are kept. No rider is created.

scenario: Name with numbers or symbols
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the test data in the name fields.
3. Click Save.
data:
First Name: Pedro Jose99
Last Name: Dela Cruz@#
expected: Saving is blocked. A message on each name field says only letters are allowed.

scenario: Name length at the limits
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each first name in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
1 character: P (reject)
2 characters: Po (accept)
50 characters: Maria Cristina Angelica Bernadette Josefina Leonor (accept)
51 characters: Maria Cristina Angelica Bernadette Josefina Leonora (reject)
expected: 1 and 51 characters are rejected with a length message. 2 and 50 characters are accepted.

scenario: Age at the 18-year limit
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each date of birth in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
Born 10/17/2008 (17 years old, reject)
Born 10/16/2008 (turns 18 today, accept)
Born 10/15/2008 (18 years and 1 day, accept)
expected: The 17-year-old date is rejected with a message that the person must be at least 18. The other two dates are accepted.

scenario: Email in an invalid format
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each email in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
pedrojose.garciaexample.com (no @)
pedrojose.garcia@ (no domain)
@example.com (no name)
pedrojose.garcia@example (no .com)
pedrojose garcia@example.com (space)
expected: Each value is rejected with a message asking for a valid email address. No rider is created.

scenario: Email already used by an account of another role
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com already exists.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing email.
3. Click Save.
data: Email: juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com
expected: Saving is blocked. A message says the email is already in use. No rider is created.

scenario: Mobile number in an invalid format
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each mobile number in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
0917ABC4567 (letters)
0917-123-456 (symbols, too short)
12345678901 (does not start with 09)
02-8123-4567 (landline)
expected: Each value is rejected with a message asking for a valid mobile number.

scenario: Mobile number length at the limits
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each mobile number in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
10 digits: 0917123456 (reject)
11 digits: 09170000001 (accept)
12 digits: 091712345678 (reject)
expected: 10 and 12 digits are rejected with a length message. 11 digits is accepted.

scenario: Mobile number that is already registered
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. An account already exists with mobile number 09171234567.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing mobile number.
3. Click Save.
expected: Saving is blocked. A message says the mobile number is already in use.

scenario: Driver's license number in an invalid format
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each license number in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
N01-23-45678 (one digit short)
N01-23-4567890 (one digit extra)
101-23-456789 (no letter)
N0123456789X (letter at the end)
expected: Each value is rejected with a message showing the format A00-00-000000.

scenario: Driver's license number already registered
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com already exists.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing license number.
3. Click Save.
data: Driver's License No.: N01-23-456789
expected: Saving is blocked. A message says the license number is already registered.

scenario: License expiry date at the limit
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each expiry date in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
Expiry 10/15/2026 (yesterday, reject)
Expiry 10/16/2026 (today, accept)
Expiry 10/17/2026 (tomorrow, accept)
expected: Yesterday's date is rejected with a message that the license is expired. Today's and tomorrow's dates are accepted.

scenario: Plate number already registered
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com already exists.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing plate number.
3. Click Save.
data: Plate Number: 123ABC
expected: Saving is blocked. A message says the plate number is already registered.

scenario: Upload documents in each accepted file type
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Upload the files in the test data.
3. Click Save.
data:
Driver's License: drivers_license.jpg (1.5 MB), then drivers_license.png (2.0 MB), then drivers_license.pdf (700 KB)
Vehicle OR/CR: or_cr.pdf (900 KB)
expected: Each file is accepted and its name or preview is shown. The rider is saved.

scenario: Upload a file type that is not accepted
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Try to upload each file in the test data to Driver's License, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
price_list.docx (320 KB)
store_banner.gif (480 KB)
installer.exe (2.1 MB)
expected: Each file is rejected with a message listing the accepted types (JPG, PNG, PDF). No rider is created.

scenario: File size at the limit
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Upload each file in the test data to Driver's License, one per attempt.
3. Click Save.
data:
size_4.9MB.jpg (accept)
size_5.0MB.jpg, exactly 5,120 KB (accept)
size_5.1MB.jpg (reject)
expected: The 4.9 MB and 5.0 MB files are accepted. The 5.1 MB file is rejected with a maximum-size message.

scenario: Click Save several times quickly
pre: The Approved logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in and the Add Rider form is open. The email, mobile number, license number and plate number in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all fields with the Account 2 data from the Test Data sheet.
2. Click Save three times in quick succession.
data: Account 2 data (Test Data sheet, column G)
expected: Only one rider is created and only one activation email is sent.

scenario: Rider activates the account with a valid password
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation and the activation email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Open the activation link from the email within 24 hours.
2. Enter and confirm the password.
3. Click Activate.
data:
Password: Rider@2026
Confirm Password: Rider@2026
expected: The password is saved. The rider's status changes from Pending Activation to Active, and the login page opens with a success message.

scenario: Set a password that breaks the password rule
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation and the activation email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Open the activation link.
2. Enter each password in both fields, one per attempt.
3. Click Activate.
data:
7 characters: Ride@26
No uppercase: rider@2026
No lowercase: RIDER@2026
No number: Rider@abcd
No special character: Rider2026
expected: Each password is rejected with a message stating the password rule. The rider stays Pending Activation.

scenario: Confirm Password does not match
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation and the activation email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Open the activation link.
2. Enter the test data in Password and Confirm Password.
3. Click Activate.
data:
Password: Rider@2026
Confirm Password: Rider@2027
expected: Activation is blocked. A message says the passwords do not match.

scenario: Open an expired activation link
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation and the activation email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Wait until more than 24 hours have passed since the email was sent (or set the link's expiry time back in the test database).
2. Open the activation link.
data: Activation link sent 24 hours and 1 minute ago
expected: A message says the link has expired. No password can be set and the rider stays Pending Activation.

scenario: Logistics resends the activation email
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation. The logistics account operations@bilishatid.example.com is logged in.
steps:
1. Open the rider list.
2. Click Resend Activation for Pedro Jose Garcia.
3. Open the first link.
4. Open the second link.
data: First activation link, then the link from the second email
expected: A new activation email is sent. The first link no longer works. The second link opens the set-password page.

scenario: Reuse the activation link after activating
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com is already Active.
steps: 1. Open the activation link that was already used.
data: Activation link from the email that was used to activate
expected: A message says the link is invalid or already used. The password cannot be changed through this link.

scenario: Rider logs in before activating
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com has status Pending Activation.
steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Enter the email and password.
3. Click Log In.
data:
Email: pedrojose.garcia@example.com
Password: Rider@2026
expected: Login is denied. The rider is not given access to any page.

scenario: Rider logs in after activating
pre: The rider pedrojose.garcia@example.com is Active.
steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Enter the email and password.
3. Click Log In.
data:
Email: pedrojose.garcia@example.com
Password: Rider@2026
expected: Login succeeds. The rider dashboard opens and shows Pedro Jose Garcia and Bilis Hatid Express Inc.

scenario: Rider is visible only to the company that created it
pre: Bilis Hatid Express Inc. created the rider Pedro Jose Garcia. Agila Cargo Movers Corp. is also an Approved logistics account.
steps:
1. Log in as the first company and open the rider list.
2. Log out.
3. Log in as the second company and open the rider list.
data:
First: operations@bilishatid.example.com / Hatid@2026
Second: admin@agilacargo.example.com / Agila#Cargo26
expected: Pedro Jose Garcia appears in the rider list of Bilis Hatid Express Inc. and does not appear in the rider list of Agila Cargo Movers Corp.

scenario: No public rider registration
pre: No user is logged in.
steps:
1. Open the public registration page and check the role choices.
2. Paste the address of the Add Rider form into the browser.
data: Add Rider form address (copy it while logged in as logistics)
expected: Rider is not offered as a self-registration role. The Add Rider address redirects to the login page.

scenario: Buyer or seller opens the Add Rider form
pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is logged in.
steps:
1. Paste the address of the Add Rider form into the browser.
2. Repeat while logged in as the seller mariaclara.santos@example.com.
data: Add Rider form address
expected: Access is denied each time (error 403 or redirect). No rider can be created.

scenario: Pending logistics account tries to add a rider
pre: A logistics account with status Pending Approval is logged in (register admin@agilacargo.example.com and verify it, but do not approve it yet).
steps:
1. Look for the Add Rider option.
2. Paste the address of the Add Rider form into the browser.
data: Add Rider form address
expected: The Add Rider option is not available. The address is denied or shows the under-review notice. No rider can be created.

scenario: Open another role's pages
pre: The Active rider account pedrojose.garcia@example.com is logged in.
steps: 1. Paste the address of each dashboard in the test data into the browser, one at a time.
data:
Logistics dashboard
Seller dashboard
Admin dashboard
expected: Access is denied each time (error 403 or redirect). No data from the other role is shown.
